map.PI = 未来现金流现值 / 初始投资: PI = present value of future cash flows / initial investment
map.单位投资带来的现值收益。: The present value return per unit of investment.
map.PI>1 项目增值。: PI>1 means the project adds value.
map.📚 深度解析：盈利指数 PI（现值/初始投资）: 📚 In-depth analysis: profitability index PI (present value / initial investment)
map.由未来现金流现值除以初始投资得 PI，>1 才可行。: Divide the present value of future cash flows by the initial investment to get PI; only PI>1 is viable.
map.和 NPV 互补，PI 看单位投入的现值回报。: Complementary to NPV: PI looks at present value return per unit invested.
map.在资金受限时比较互斥项目的单位投资产出效率。: Compare the output efficiency per unit of investment among mutually exclusive projects when capital is constrained.
map.未来现金流现值 = 300/1.1+400/1.21+500/1.331 ≈ 9: Present value of future cash flows = 300/1.1+400/1.21+500/1.331 ≈ 979, PI = 979/1000 = 0.979 < 1, marginally not viable at a 10% discount rate (consistent with NPV≈−21). If the present value reached 1200 then PI=1.2 and it would be viable.
map.先把第 1~3 期折现求和：500/1.1+500/1.21+500/1.331: First discount and sum periods 1~3: 500/1.1+500/1.21+500/1.331≈1243.43 CNY; PI=1243.43/1000≈1.243, i.e. every 1 CNY invested brings about 1.243 CNY of present value return.
map.PI 和 NPV 关系？: What is the relationship between PI and NPV?
map.PI>1 等价于 NPV>0；PI 是相对指标便于不同规模项目比效率，NPV 是: PI>1 is equivalent to NPV>0; PI is a relative measure that compares efficiency across projects of different sizes, while NPV is the absolute value added.
map.对单个独立项目完全等价：PI=未来现金流现值÷初始投资，PI>1 即 NPV>0: For a single independent project they are exactly equivalent: PI = present value of future cash flows ÷ initial investment, so PI>1 means NPV>0. In the example, an initial investment of 1000 CNY and a present value of 1243.43 CNY correspond to NPV≈243.43 CNY. But when ranking mutually exclusive projects under a capital constraint, PI ranks by efficiency and NPV by absolute value added, so the two may select different projects.
